title: Why China is winning the EV war
speaker: Vox
zh: 【Vox】為什麼中國會贏得電動車戰爭（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In 2024, Ford Motors cut back production on their F-150 Lightning, the electric version
cues.en: In 2024, Ford Motors cut back production on their F-150 Lightning, the electric version
cues.zh: 2024 年，福特汽車公司削減了電動版 F-150 Lightning 的產量

cues.text: of their popular pickup truck.
cues.en: of their popular pickup truck.
cues.zh: 他們受歡迎的皮卡車。

cues.text: Sales on the Lightning had tanked, in part because it costs more than its gas powered counterpart.
cues.en: Sales on the Lightning had tanked, in part because it costs more than its gas powered counterpart.
cues.zh: 閃電的銷售量大幅下滑，部分原因是它的成本高於汽油動力的同類產品。

cues.text: This isn't just a problem for Ford.
cues.en: This isn't just a problem for Ford.
cues.zh: 這不僅是福特面臨的問題。

cues.text: The average price of a new EV in the US is about $55,000,
cues.en: The average price of a new EV in the US is about $55,000,
cues.zh: 美國一輛新電動車的平均價格約為 55,000 美元，

cues.text: making electric cars a hard sell for most US consumers at a time when EV adoption is critical for our climate goals.
cues.en: making electric cars a hard sell for most US consumers at a time when EV adoption is critical for our climate goals.
cues.zh: 在電動車的採用對我們的氣候目標至關重要之際，電動車對大多數美國消費者來說很難銷售。

cues.text: Roughly 40% of the cost to produce an electric vehicle is in the battery.
cues.en: Roughly 40% of the cost to produce an electric vehicle is in the battery.
cues.zh: 生產電動車的成本中約 40% 是在電池上。

cues.text: So in 2023, it was reported that Ford was looking at sites
cues.en: So in 2023, it was reported that Ford was looking at sites
cues.zh: 據報道，2023年福特正在考慮選址

cues.text: in Virginia or Michigan for a new battery plant that could help lower its costs.
cues.en: in Virginia or Michigan for a new battery plant that could help lower its costs.
cues.zh: 在維吉尼亞州或密西根州建立新的電池工廠，有助於降低成本。

cues.text: But there's a catch.
cues.en: But there's a catch.
cues.zh: 但有一個問題。

cues.text: The battery technology it would use is from a company based here, in Fujian Province, China.
cues.en: The battery technology it would use is from a company based here, in Fujian Province, China.
cues.zh: 它將使用的電池技術來自中國福建省的一家公司。

cues.text: That company is CATL, the largest battery maker in the world.
cues.en: That company is CATL, the largest battery maker in the world.
cues.zh: 該公司就是全球最大的電池製造商CATL。

cues.text: Virginia's governor decided to kill the battery plant proposal in his state
cues.en: Virginia's governor decided to kill the battery plant proposal in his state
cues.zh: 維吉尼亞州州長決定取消該州電池廠提案

cues.text: because of its links to China — They are influenced, if not controlled, by the Chinese Communist Party.
cues.en: because of its links to China — They are influenced, if not controlled, by the Chinese Communist Party.
cues.zh: 因為它與中國的連結——它們即使不受中國共產黨的控制，也受到影響。

cues.text: putting Ford’s CEO on the defense — Look, this plant is a wholly owned subsidiary of Ford.
cues.en: putting Ford’s CEO on the defense — Look, this plant is a wholly owned subsidiary of Ford.
cues.zh: 讓福特執行長進行辯護——看，這家工廠是福特的全資子公司。

cues.text: and leaving them to look elsewhere for a site.
cues.en: and leaving them to look elsewhere for a site.
cues.zh: 並讓他們去其他地方尋找網站。

cues.text: This battery plant got caught up in a broader trade war between the US and China,
cues.en: This battery plant got caught up in a broader trade war between the US and China,
cues.zh: 這家電池廠陷入了中美更廣泛的貿易戰，

cues.text: in reaction to the extraordinary rise of China's electric vehicle market.
cues.en: in reaction to the extraordinary rise of China's electric vehicle market.
cues.zh: 以因應中國電動車市場的非凡崛起。

cues.text: They make up over half of all EV sales globally, and in just a few short years, have brought slick
cues.en: They make up over half of all EV sales globally, and in just a few short years, have brought slick
cues.zh: 它們佔全球電動車銷量的一半以上，並且在短短幾年內就帶來了良好的業績

cues.text: and affordable electric cars to the market.
cues.en: and affordable electric cars to the market.
cues.zh: 並將價格實惠的電動車推向市場。

cues.text: Key to this rise is the electric vehicle battery.
cues.en: Key to this rise is the electric vehicle battery.
cues.zh: 這一增長的關鍵是電動車電池。

cues.text: This part of the EV is where China has really come to dominate the global market.
cues.en: This part of the EV is where China has really come to dominate the global market.
cues.zh: 電動車的這一部分是中國真正主導全球市場的地方。

cues.text: So how did Chinese companies create the world's leading EV battery?
cues.en: So how did Chinese companies create the world's leading EV battery?
cues.zh: 那麼中國企業是如何打造出全球領先的電動車電池的呢？

cues.text: And can US automakers make an affordable electric car without it?
cues.en: And can US automakers make an affordable electric car without it?
cues.zh: 如果沒有它，美國汽車製造商能生產出價格實惠的電動車嗎？

cues.text: The first major reason for why China's companies were able to develop their EV battery
cues.en: The first major reason for why China's companies were able to develop their EV battery
cues.zh: 中國企業能夠開發電動車電池的第一個主要原因

cues.text: is due to a huge amount of government support.
cues.en: is due to a huge amount of government support.
cues.zh: 得益於政府的大力支援。

cues.text: Roughly 20 years ago, China was on track to become the world's largest importer of oil,
cues.en: Roughly 20 years ago, China was on track to become the world's largest importer of oil,
cues.zh: 大約20年前，中國有望成為世界上最大的石油進口國，

cues.text: so electrifying its car fleet would help it become more energy independent.
cues.en: so electrifying its car fleet would help it become more energy independent.
cues.zh: 因此，為其車隊提供電氣化將有助於其變得更加能源獨立。

cues.text: Not to mention a growing air pollution problem in China's cities, in part due to car emissions.
cues.en: Not to mention a growing air pollution problem in China's cities, in part due to car emissions.
cues.zh: 更不用說中國城市日益嚴重的空氣汙染問題，部分原因是汽車廢氣排放。

cues.text: What the EVs had going for them was that the head of the Ministry of Science and Technology
cues.en: What the EVs had going for them was that the head of the Ministry of Science and Technology
cues.zh: 電動車的優勢在於科技部部長

cues.text: was a big believer in this.
cues.en: was a big believer in this.
cues.zh: 對此深信不疑。

cues.text: And his sense was that Chinese companies were just never going to be able to compete on internal combustion
cues.en: And his sense was that Chinese companies were just never going to be able to compete on internal combustion
cues.zh: 他的感覺是，中國公司永遠無法在內燃機領域競爭

cues.text: engine technology.
cues.en: engine technology.
cues.zh: 引擎技術。

cues.text: That’s how you get this package of policies that really supported what the Chinese government defined as “new energy vehicles.”
cues.en: That’s how you get this package of policies that really supported what the Chinese government defined as “new energy vehicles.”
cues.zh: 這就是真正支援中國政府定義的「新能源汽車」的一攬子政策的方式。

cues.text: Companies making the cars can get a subsidy whenever they sell a car.
cues.en: Companies making the cars can get a subsidy whenever they sell a car.
cues.zh: 生產汽車的公司每當出售汽車時都可以獲得補貼。

cues.text: We're also talking about, they're getting cheap land leases from the government.
cues.en: We're also talking about, they're getting cheap land leases from the government.
cues.zh: 我們還在談論，他們從政府那裡獲得了廉價的土地租賃。

cues.text: They're getting cheap loans from the state-owned banks.
cues.en: They're getting cheap loans from the state-owned banks.
cues.zh: 他們從國有銀行獲得廉價貸款。

cues.text: According to one estimate, from 2009 to 2022, the Chinese government gave out $29 billion
cues.en: According to one estimate, from 2009 to 2022, the Chinese government gave out $29 billion
cues.zh: 根據一項估計，從 2009 年到 2022 年，中國政府撥款 290 億美元

cues.text: in the form of subsidies, research spending, and tax breaks, to the EV industry.
cues.en: in the form of subsidies, research spending, and tax breaks, to the EV industry.
cues.zh: 以補貼、研究支出和稅收減免的形式向電動汽車產業提供補貼。

cues.text: And starting around 2009, local governments also gave Chinese companies an instant market by contracting them
cues.en: And starting around 2009, local governments also gave Chinese companies an instant market by contracting them
cues.zh: 而從2009年左右開始，地方政府也透過承包給中國企業提供了即時市場。

cues.text: to electrify their bus and taxi fleets.
cues.en: to electrify their bus and taxi fleets.
cues.zh: 為他們的公車和計程車隊提供電氣化。

cues.text: The city of Shenzhen's fleet of 16,000 buses was electrified by BYD
cues.en: The city of Shenzhen's fleet of 16,000 buses was electrified by BYD
cues.zh: 比亞迪為深圳市 16,000 輛公車實現電動化

cues.text: before it became the world's largest EV company.
cues.en: before it became the world's largest EV company.
cues.zh: 在成為全球最大的電動車公司之前。

cues.text: To get consumers on board, governments offered them generous subsidies too,
cues.en: To get consumers on board, governments offered them generous subsidies too,
cues.zh: 為了讓消費者參與進來，政府也向他們提供了慷慨的補貼，

cues.text: along with other benefits.
cues.en: along with other benefits.
cues.zh: 以及其他好處。

cues.text: Like discounts on charging, favorable parking, traffic congestion-related policies that EVs get a break on.
cues.en: Like discounts on charging, favorable parking, traffic congestion-related policies that EVs get a break on.
cues.zh: 例如充電折扣、優惠停車、電動車可以享受的與交通擁堵相關的政策。

cues.text: EVs actually have a different colored license plate, even, so it's very visible.
cues.en: EVs actually have a different colored license plate, even, so it's very visible.
cues.zh: 電動車實際上甚至有不同顏色的車牌，因此非常明顯。

cues.text: And so people see, oh, that's an EV.
cues.en: And so people see, oh, that's an EV.
cues.zh: 所以人們看到，哦，那是一輛電動車。

cues.text: They get all the special treatment.
cues.en: They get all the special treatment.
cues.zh: 他們得到了所有的特殊待遇。

cues.text: But the battery wasn't very good in the early days.
cues.en: But the battery wasn't very good in the early days.
cues.zh: 但早期的電池不太好。

cues.text: And so the Chinese government goes in and starts introducing stricter standards of batteries,
cues.en: And so the Chinese government goes in and starts introducing stricter standards of batteries,
cues.zh: 因此中國政府介入並開始引入更嚴格的電池標準，

cues.text: saying, well, you'll only qualify for this credit if your battery density reaches this level.
cues.en: saying, well, you'll only qualify for this credit if your battery density reaches this level.
cues.zh: 說，好吧，只有當您的電池密度達到這個水平時，您才有資格獲得此積分。

cues.text: Consumer EV sales in China exploded, and when it did, the government
cues.en: Consumer EV sales in China exploded, and when it did, the government
cues.zh: 中國的消費電動車銷量呈現爆炸性成長，當這種情況發生時，政府

cues.text: did something important to protect their own battery industry.
cues.en: did something important to protect their own battery industry.
cues.zh: 為保護自己的電池產業做了一些重要的事情。

cues.text: When foreign car companies like GM and Tesla wanted to sell their EVs in China,
cues.en: When foreign car companies like GM and Tesla wanted to sell their EVs in China,
cues.zh: 當通用汽車和特斯拉等外國汽車公司想在中國銷售電動車時，

cues.text: the government made a rule that their cars must use Chinese-made batteries to qualify for consumer subsidies.
cues.en: the government made a rule that their cars must use Chinese-made batteries to qualify for consumer subsidies.
cues.zh: 政府規定，他們的汽車必須使用中國製造的電池，才有資格獲得消費者補貼。

cues.text: China’s central government phased out consumer subsidies in 2022,
cues.en: China’s central government phased out consumer subsidies in 2022,
cues.zh: 中國中央政府將於2022年逐步取消消費補貼

cues.text: but the demand had been created.
cues.en: but the demand had been created.
cues.zh: 但需求已經被創造了。

cues.text: In 2024, over half of new car sales in China were electric.
cues.en: In 2024, over half of new car sales in China were electric.
cues.zh: 2024年，中國超過一半的新車銷量是電動車。

cues.text: This is a milestone, because half is a big thing.
cues.en: This is a milestone, because half is a big thing.
cues.zh: 這是一個里程碑，因為一半是一件大事。

cues.text: It means that the majority of the people are actually preferring EVs over gas cars now.
cues.en: It means that the majority of the people are actually preferring EVs over gas cars now.
cues.zh: 這意味著大多數人現在實際上更喜歡電動車而不是燃油汽車。

cues.text: The second way Chinese battery companies became so dominant is through the supply chain
cues.en: The second way Chinese battery companies became so dominant is through the supply chain
cues.zh: 中國電池企業主導的第二種方式是透過供應鏈

cues.text: for the battery components.
cues.en: for the battery components.
cues.zh: 用於電池元件。

cues.text: The type of battery that typically goes into electric vehicles is called a lithium-ion battery.
cues.en: The type of battery that typically goes into electric vehicles is called a lithium-ion battery.
cues.zh: 通常用於電動車的電池型別稱為鋰離子電池。

cues.text: The four main components of the battery cell are the cathode, the anode,
cues.en: The four main components of the battery cell are the cathode, the anode,
cues.zh: 電池芯的四個主要部件是正極、負極、

cues.text: the electrolyte solution, and a separator.
cues.en: the electrolyte solution, and a separator.
cues.zh: 電解質溶液和隔膜。

cues.text: The cathode is usually packed with nickel, cobalt, and manganese.
cues.en: The cathode is usually packed with nickel, cobalt, and manganese.
cues.zh: 陰極通常填充有鎳、鈷和錳。

cues.text: The anode uses graphite, and the electrolyte is made up of mostly lithium salts.
cues.en: The anode uses graphite, and the electrolyte is made up of mostly lithium salts.
cues.zh: 陽極使用石墨，電解質主要由鋰鹽組成。

cues.text: Over the past several years, Chinese companies started acquiring ownership stakes
cues.en: Over the past several years, Chinese companies started acquiring ownership stakes
cues.zh: 過去幾年，中國企業開始收購股權

cues.text: in mines around the world where these minerals exist.
cues.en: in mines around the world where these minerals exist.
cues.zh: 在世界各地存在這些礦物的礦山中。

cues.text: So they're sure that, if we control the production, then we control the price.
cues.en: So they're sure that, if we control the production, then we control the price.
cues.zh: 所以他們確信，如果我們控制了產量，那麼我們就控制了價格。

cues.text: The effect is that Chinese companies control significant percentages of the world's supply of the minerals needed for batteries.
cues.en: The effect is that Chinese companies control significant percentages of the world's supply of the minerals needed for batteries.
cues.zh: 結果是，中國公司控制了全球電池所需礦物供應的很大一部分。

cues.text: But where China really controls the supply chain are the steps after mining.
cues.en: But where China really controls the supply chain are the steps after mining.
cues.zh: 但中國真正控制供應鏈的是採礦之後的步驟。

cues.text: No matter who mines the minerals, China refines a vast majority of them.
cues.en: No matter who mines the minerals, China refines a vast majority of them.
cues.zh: 無論誰開採這些礦物，中國都會提煉其中的絕大多數。

cues.text: This is the step where factories grind down raw mined materials and extract the desired mineral from it.
cues.en: This is the step where factories grind down raw mined materials and extract the desired mineral from it.
cues.zh: 這是工廠研磨原始開採材料並從中提取所需礦物質的步驟。

cues.text: It's pretty polluting.
cues.en: It's pretty polluting.
cues.zh: 這是相當汙染的。

cues.text: That's why you don't see that much refining happening in developed countries.
cues.en: That's why you don't see that much refining happening in developed countries.
cues.zh: 這就是為什麼已開發國家沒有看到如此多的煉油活動。

cues.text: Chinese plants then also manufactured the vast majority of the four components
cues.en: Chinese plants then also manufactured the vast majority of the four components
cues.zh: 中國工廠隨後也生產了這四種零件的絕大多數

cues.text: of the EV batteries: the cathode, the anode, the electrolyte and the separator, and put them together
cues.en: of the EV batteries: the cathode, the anode, the electrolyte and the separator, and put them together
cues.zh: EV電池的組成：正極、負極、電解液和隔膜，並將它們放在一起

cues.text: to make the battery cell.
cues.en: to make the battery cell.
cues.zh: 來製造電池。

cues.text: Because you already had pretty developed manufacturing for batteries aimed at electronics.
cues.en: Because you already had pretty developed manufacturing for batteries aimed at electronics.
cues.zh: 因為你們已經擁有相當發達的電子產品電池製造能力。

cues.text: So BYD is actually one of those examples, they started by producing batteries
cues.en: So BYD is actually one of those examples, they started by producing batteries
cues.zh: 所以比亞迪其實就是其中之一，他們是從生產電池開始的

cues.text: for electronics in the 90s. And then it got into producing EVs.
cues.en: for electronics in the 90s. And then it got into producing EVs.
cues.zh: 對於 90 年代的電子產品。然後它開始生產電動車。

cues.text: The US was never a battery manufacturing player, historically speaking, in lithium ion.
cues.en: The US was never a battery manufacturing player, historically speaking, in lithium ion.
cues.zh: 從歷史上看，美國從來就不是鋰離子電池製造大國。

cues.text: It was previously Japan and Korea.
cues.en: It was previously Japan and Korea.
cues.zh: 以前是日本和韓國。

cues.text: China has now superseded both.
cues.en: China has now superseded both.
cues.zh: 中國現在已經取代了兩者。

cues.text: China’s control of the battery supply chain is so encompassing
cues.en: China’s control of the battery supply chain is so encompassing
cues.zh: 中國對電池供應鏈的控制如此全面

cues.text: that after the Biden administration passed a rule saying no more than half of the batteries’ components or minerals
cues.en: that after the Biden administration passed a rule saying no more than half of the batteries’ components or minerals
cues.zh: 拜登政府透過一項規定，規定電池的成分或礦物質不得超過一半

cues.text: could be Chinese-sourced to qualify for tax credits, only an estimated
cues.en: could be Chinese-sourced to qualify for tax credits, only an estimated
cues.zh: 可能來自中國才有資格獲得稅收抵免，但只是估計

cues.text: 20% of EV models qualified.
cues.en: 20% of EV models qualified.
cues.zh: 20% 的電動車車型合格。

cues.text: With their market dominance, Chinese companies have been able to lead the world in battery innovation. In the past two years,
cues.en: With their market dominance, Chinese companies have been able to lead the world in battery innovation. In the past two years,
cues.zh: 憑藉市場主導地位，中國企業在電池創新方面一直處於世界領先地位。在過去的兩年裡，

cues.text: Chinese companies figured out how to avoid using the two most expensive
cues.en: Chinese companies figured out how to avoid using the two most expensive
cues.zh: 中國公司想出如何避免使用兩種最昂貴的

cues.text: battery minerals, nickel and cobalt.
cues.en: battery minerals, nickel and cobalt.
cues.zh: 電池礦物，鎳和鈷。

cues.text: They did this by innovating on battery technology called lithium iron phosphate, or LFP.
cues.en: They did this by innovating on battery technology called lithium iron phosphate, or LFP.
cues.zh: 他們透過創新稱為磷酸鐵鋰（LFP）的電池技術來實現這一目標。

cues.text: In 2023, CATL announced an LFP battery that could power a car for 370 miles on
cues.en: In 2023, CATL announced an LFP battery that could power a car for 370 miles on
cues.zh: 2023年，寧德時代宣佈推出磷酸鐵鋰電池，可為汽車提供動力，行駛370英里

cues.text: just a ten-minute charge, and BYD has developed their own version of an LFP battery, too.
cues.en: just a ten-minute charge, and BYD has developed their own version of an LFP battery, too.
cues.zh: 只需十分鐘的充電時間，比亞迪也開發了自己的磷酸鋰鐵電池。

cues.text: It's called blade battery.
cues.en: It's called blade battery.
cues.zh: 它被稱為刀片電池。

cues.text: It’s like a very thin, very long blade.
cues.en: It’s like a very thin, very long blade.
cues.zh: 它就像一把非常薄、非常長的刀片。

cues.text: But basically they’re saying that by using that shape, it can cram more batteries into the same space.
cues.en: But basically they’re saying that by using that shape, it can cram more batteries into the same space.
cues.zh: 但基本上他們是說，透過使用這種形狀，可以在同一空間中塞入更多電池。

cues.text: So in that way, like, the same size of a car can travel farther.
cues.en: So in that way, like, the same size of a car can travel farther.
cues.zh: 這樣一來，同樣大小的汽車可以行駛更遠的距離。

cues.text: Today, LFP batteries are a growing share of all EV batteries,
cues.en: Today, LFP batteries are a growing share of all EV batteries,
cues.zh: 如今，磷酸鐵鋰電池在所有電動車電池中所佔的份額越來越大，

cues.text: and nearly all of them are manufactured in China.
cues.en: and nearly all of them are manufactured in China.
cues.zh: 幾乎所有這些都是在中國製造的。

cues.text: But not for long.
cues.en: But not for long.
cues.zh: 但不會持續太久。

cues.text: CATL has built battery plants in Germany, and has plans to build one in Hungary for the European auto market.
cues.en: CATL has built battery plants in Germany, and has plans to build one in Hungary for the European auto market.
cues.zh: CATL已在德國建有電池工廠，並計劃在匈牙利建造一座電池工廠，供應歐洲汽車市場。

cues.text: And Ford ended up finding a home for its CATL battery plant in the town of Marshall, Michigan.
cues.en: And Ford ended up finding a home for its CATL battery plant in the town of Marshall, Michigan.
cues.zh: 福特最終在密西根州馬歇爾鎮為其寧德時代電池工廠找到了落腳點。

cues.text: The project has triggered a US House investigation.
cues.en: The project has triggered a US House investigation.
cues.zh: 該專案已引發美國眾議院調查。

cues.text: But if it goes through, it'll be the first LFP plant in the US.
cues.en: But if it goes through, it'll be the first LFP plant in the US.
cues.zh: 但如果順利透過，這將是美國第一座磷酸鋰鐵工廠。

cues.text: All of these factors have made Chinese EV batteries virtually impossible
cues.en: All of these factors have made Chinese EV batteries virtually impossible
cues.zh: 所有這些因素使得中國電動車電池幾乎不可能

cues.text: to avoid in the global transition to electric vehicles.
cues.en: to avoid in the global transition to electric vehicles.
cues.zh: 避免在全球範圍內向電動車過渡。

cues.text: Was there not a viable alternative?
cues.en: Was there not a viable alternative?
cues.zh: 難道就沒有可行的替代方案嗎？

cues.text: No there wasn't.
cues.en: No there wasn't.
cues.zh: 不，沒有。

cues.text: LFP technology is very well developed.
cues.en: LFP technology is very well developed.
cues.zh: LFP技術非常發達。

cues.text: The battery business is a global business.
cues.en: The battery business is a global business.
cues.zh: 電池業務是一項全球性業務。

cues.text: And, this was, there were no alternatives.
cues.en: And, this was, there were no alternatives.
cues.zh: 而且，這就是，別無選擇。

cues.text: There are some concerns about whether China's government support of the EV industry
cues.en: There are some concerns about whether China's government support of the EV industry
cues.zh: 人們擔心中國政府是否會支援電動車產業

cues.text: amounts to unfair global competition, as well as human rights and environmental concerns
cues.en: amounts to unfair global competition, as well as human rights and environmental concerns
cues.zh: 構成不公平的全球競爭以及人權和環境議題

cues.text: associated with China's battery supply chain.
cues.en: associated with China's battery supply chain.
cues.zh: 與中國電池供應鏈相關。

cues.text: The US is investing their own government support to build up its battery industry.
cues.en: The US is investing their own government support to build up its battery industry.
cues.zh: 美國正在投資本國政府的支援來建立其電池產業。

cues.text: Bloomberg estimated it would cost $82 billion for the US
cues.en: Bloomberg estimated it would cost $82 billion for the US
cues.zh: 彭博社估計美國將花費 820 億美元

cues.text: to meet their own domestic demand by 2030.
cues.en: to meet their own domestic demand by 2030.
cues.zh: 至2030年滿足國內需求。

cues.text: So it might be possible in the future, but that's no help right now, when we desperately need to transition to electric vehicles
cues.en: So it might be possible in the future, but that's no help right now, when we desperately need to transition to electric vehicles
cues.zh: 所以未來可能有可能，但現在這沒有幫助，因為我們迫切需要過渡到電動車

cues.text: to wean ourselves from fossil fuels, and US automakers are struggling
cues.en: to wean ourselves from fossil fuels, and US automakers are struggling
cues.zh: 為了擺脫對化石燃料的依賴，美國汽車製造商正在苦苦掙扎

cues.text: to give consumers affordable options.
cues.en: to give consumers affordable options.
cues.zh: 為消費者提供負擔得起的選擇。

cues.text: So for now, we'll have to decide whether our desire to keep our distance from China
cues.en: So for now, we'll have to decide whether our desire to keep our distance from China
cues.zh: 所以現在我們必須決定是否希望與中國保持距離

cues.text: outweighs our goals of going electric.
cues.en: outweighs our goals of going electric.
cues.zh: 超過了我們實現電動化的目標。
